title: EN 18286:2026 to the EU AI Act (amended)

useCase.intendedUsers: Lead auditors and reviewers on engagements that use either framework as criteria.
useCase.purpose: Record which AI Act provisions the harmonised QMS standard relates to, including the scope of its presumption of conformity.
useCase.assumptions: Relationships compare what each requirement demands, not how an organisation implements it. No inference may be drawn from requirements that are not mapped. Every entry is a draft until the clause numbers are confirmed against licensed copies (#57).

entries.justification: Annex ZA relates these clauses to Art. 17(1); Art. 17(2) to (4) are outside it, and the clauses also cover topics beyond Art. 17. At article level the two only overlap.

legalEffect.basis: EN 18286:2026 Annex ZA; reference published by Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/2274.
legalEffect.conditions: Only for the Art. 17(1) provisions listed in Annex ZA, and only while the reference stays published in the Official Journal. A presumption follows from conformity with the standard; it is not an audit conclusion.

provenance.note: Competitor-authored summary; confirm against Annex ZA of the licensed standard and Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/2274 (Q8, #57).

entries.justification: Secondary sources relate the realisation clause to the first sentence of Art. 11(1) only; the content of the documentation is fixed by Annex IV.

legalEffect.basis: EN 18286:2026 Annex ZA, as described by secondary sources; reference published by Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/2274.
legalEffect.conditions: Only for the first sentence of Art. 11(1) if Annex ZA lists it, and only while the reference stays published. Not an audit conclusion.
